name: V-stabilized advantage DQL
tagline: DQL actor with twin Q, but a separate IQL-style V(s) is trained by expectile regression and used both as the critic's TD target and as the inference advantage signal.
init_recovers: default DQL when V == 0 (and we use Q-target on sampled next actions)
diff_from_baseline: Adds an IDQL-style state-value head trained with expectile regression and uses V(s') as the critic's TD target (so the critic no longer needs to sample next-state actions); inference reranks candidates by Q_target_min - V instead of raw Q.

name: Confidence-gated advantage DQL
tagline: Standard DQL critic + actor, but the actor adds a sigmoid-gated advantage term (twin-Q LCB minus dataset Q) and an MSE anchor back to dataset actions when the gate is low.

key_hyperparams.name: lcb_penalty
key_hyperparams.role: twin-Q gap penalty in robust score

key_hyperparams.name: dql_blend
key_hyperparams.role: DQL vs gated-advantage mix in q_loss

init_recovers: DQL baseline when gate is constant 1 and dql_blend=1
diff_from_baseline: Keeps DQL's critic and BC term, but the policy Q-loss becomes a 70/30 blend of DQL's normalized loss and a gated advantage loss using a robust LCB twin-Q score, plus a (1-gate)-weighted MSE anchor back to dataset actions; inference reranks by the same robust score.

name: AW-DQL: CQL + expectile-weighted Q
tagline: DQL augmented with a CQL penalty on the critic and an expectile-weighted Q maximization on the actor (positive-advantage actions weighted tau, negative weighted 1-tau).

key_hyperparams.name: EXPECTILE_TAU
key_hyperparams.role: asymmetric weighting between positive and negative advantage

init_recovers: DQL baseline when CQL_ALPHA=0 and EXPECTILE_TAU=0.5
diff_from_baseline: Adds a CQL penalty (E[Q(random)] - E[Q(data)]) to the DQL critic loss and replaces the actor's randomized DQL Q-term with an expectile-weighted Q maximisation that down-weights actions whose Q drops below the dataset action's; inference selection unchanged.

name: Default DQL (no change)
tagline: Submission keeps the default Diffusion Q-Learning template unchanged: BC + DQL Q-loss actor, twin-Q critic, softmax candidate selection at inference.

key_hyperparams.name: branch_prob
key_hyperparams.role: random Q1/Q2 branch in actor q-loss

init_recovers: Diffusion Q-Learning baseline (this is exactly the template)
diff_from_baseline: No real change: the editable region is left identical to the DQL default template (twin-Q critic + BC + DQL Q-loss + softmax candidate selection).
